title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore West on 1969-03-01
lineage: Dat (Panasonic SV-3700) > Tascam DA-3000 > wav 16/48; Joe Noel Edited & Mastered in Audacity: Wave > Flac 16/48; Checksum & tags created in xACT
source: flac16/48kHz; SBD > 2-track Master Reels > Dat; Charlie Miller

ai_review.summary: Superb soundboard recording of an explosive show highlighted by a raging Cosmic Charlie
ai_review.review: Fans rave about this tape‑companion as an endlessly fresh, face‑melting performance. The SBD source is praised for its superb clarity, and the set is described as a pure rager with Cosmic Charlie standing out as a primal‑Dead favorite.

ai_rating.rationale: All three reviewers give high marks (5, 5, 4) and emphasize both the stellar sound quality and the energetic performance; limited number of reviews keeps confidence at medium.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Superb clarity and freshness noted by multiple reviewers; no complaints about dropouts, muddiness, or balance issues.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Consistently high‑energy throughout; reviewers describe the entire show as a rager that stays fresh from start to finish.
